points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: CMake and README exist, but no clean rebuild was performed and the submitted source cannot reproduce the claimed MPI/transient outputs.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp parses solve, --case and --output and rejects unknown/missing arguments.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Reader, mesh, solver, and plotting files are separated, but the production path is serial-only and incomplete.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No internal executable wrapper was found; trust policy precludes external similarity investigation.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: CaseReader consumes JSON rather than branching solely on the two benchmark mesh names.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: main.cpp invokes mesh read and FVMSolver::solve only on rank 0; no partition/halo/reduction solve path exists.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Geometry contains placeholder cell-volume handling and VTK connectivity is explicitly placeholder; no credible parallel robustness evidence.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: No tests or reproducible rank comparison were submitted; report validation fails on the Re200 wake manifest requirement.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Readable short C++ modules, but tracked source contains explicit placeholder paths and stale claims.

disqualification_flags.flag: Code only reads the two benchmark mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
metadata.json marks incomplete/failed runs as successful
Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
